description:
** CAUTION- A large debris torrent has come down across a Hagensborg Loop section of the network. Please avoid this area and follow the other trails that are not affected.

The Schoolhouse Falls Trails are accessed via the new trail adjacent to the Sir Alexander McKenzie Secondary School field. This trail network is scenic for hikers and also a fun ride for mountain bikers winding through a mix of coniferous and deciduous second growth forest. The trails are great for beginner riders with sections that even experienced riders will appreciate. The Schoolhouse Falls Trail connects to the Hagensborg Loop Trail which leads to Nooklikonnik Creek. There are loop options within the trail network for access back to the parking lot.

These trails are located in the traditional and unceded territory of the Nuxalkmc, or the Nuxalk People.
directions: There are two options for accessing each end of the trail, one located along the Klonnick Road and another at the entrance to Sir Alexander McKenzie Secondary School. The new trail at the far end of the school field leads directly to the network of trails. Please respect the school district property and use the designated access trail that leads from the trailhead parking lot.
